title: Update pnpm lockfile for examples/basic workspace package
body:
CI failing on `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` because `examples/basic` package was added without updating the lockfile.

## Changes

- Updated `pnpm-lock.yaml` to include `examples/basic` workspace entry with dependencies: `@objectstack/spec@workspace:*`, `typescript@^5.0.0`, `tsx@^4.21.0`
